items.raw_excerpt: Film, poetry and a new collection come together at Bíó Paradís on August 21 in memory of poet and cultural journalist Ásgeir H. Ingólfsson.

items.summary_en: The Student Representative Council at CPUT says the university did not talk to them before making its Financial Recovery Plan. Students want the plan to be more open. They held a protest about it.

items.raw_excerpt: On World Elephant Day, leaders advocate for transforming human-elephant conflict into coexistence through innovative conservation initiatives.

items.raw_excerpt: The utility says construction of the new 20-megalitre Carlswald Reservoir is 25% complete.
